latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
This release fixes entry URLs that redirect client-side (meta refresh, JavaScript `location` changes or `window.open`) failing the connectivity check with error 14; redirects are now followed and every client-side hop is vetted by the SSRF guard. Scans now default to same-domain (treating `www.domain.tld` and `domain.tld` as the same site), sitemap URLs are only strictly scoped to the entry hostname when "same hostname" is selected, and local sitemap scans respect same-domain redirects. The scan engine now reports the HTTP status and reason for every page it scans, skips or fails, and the desktop app's scanning screen parses the new progress format so URLs display correctly. Trust in the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs is now removed offline at build time, which fixes scans hanging until timeout behind TLS-intercepting proxies (e.g. Cloudflare Gateway, Zscaler, WARP). `file://` entry URLs are also redacted in Sentry telemetry, and Electron is upgraded to 43.7.0.

#### Improvements
* feat: include HTTP status and errors in crawl progress logs by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/919

#### Fixes
* fix: parse statusCode/message in engine 0.11.24 crawl progress lines by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/319
* fix: follow client-side redirects on entry URL (error 14) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/915
* fix: default scans to same-domain; scope sitemaps only on same-hostname by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/913
* fix: respect same-domain redirects in local sitemap scans by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/909
* fix: report file:// entryUrl as file://redacted in Sentry telemetry by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/912

#### Security
* fix: replace EnableOnlineRevocationChecks with offline NSS distrust for eMudhra intermediates by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/918

#### Version bumps
* chore: bump version to v0.11.24 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/313

#### Dependencies
* chore(deps-dev): bump electron from 43.5.0 to 43.7.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/312
* chore(deps): bump follow-redirects from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/309
* chore(deps): bump follow-redirects from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/906
* chore(deps-dev): bump launch-editor from 2.14.1 to 2.14.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/311
* chore(deps-dev): bump qs from 6.15.3 to 6.17.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/314
* chore(deps): bump postcss-selector-parser from 7.1.5 to 7.1.7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/315
* chore(deps-dev): bump fast-uri from 3.1.7 to 3.1.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/316
